subject.title: fix(openclaw): harden bridge identity and smoke locking

question: Should Crabline adopt per-owner smoke-lock directories with the canonical directory retained as a compatibility marker for released processes?
rationale: This changes a persistent inter-process coordination protocol, and focused unit tests cannot determine the intended mixed-version upgrade contract.

options.title: Require mixed-version proof
options.body: Keep the proposed design but demonstrate that released and new processes cannot overlap or incorrectly release each other's locks.

options.title: Preserve canonical ownership
options.body: Land the bridge and durability fixes while retaining the current single canonical lock ownership model.

options.title: Accept a format boundary
options.body: Adopt the new layout as an intentional compatibility boundary with explicit operator and upgrade expectations.

recommendation.title: Require mixed-version proof
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed design but demonstrate that released and new processes cannot overlap or incorrectly release each other's locks.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence ties this repository member directly to the lock redesign and all commits in the current branch.
